notes.title: Update 1 is now out!
notes.notes:
Hey There,

We finally launched our game last week and thank you all for your support on that!

It's great to see all the reactions and reviews we got. Instead of resting, we heard you and carefully went over all your feedback whether it's a bug report or criticism and here we are with our first update which includes these improvements so far :

[list]
[*] Online play now allows you to continue where you left off! This means whether you are playing local or online, you can hop back to your progress to resume. There is a simple rule on online, on random matchmaking, you'll get matched with people who are at the same check point as you are and if you invite a friend to play together, your the inviters chekcpoint is where the game will resume.
[*] We have fixed all known stability issues on the Online play and tested it for quite some hours to ensure there is no visible issue to interrupt your experience.
[*] New short campaign mode! We found out that some of you wanted a shorter experience for a more arcade like feeling in duration so that's now possible with short campaign.
[*] We have tweaked the levels and some small gameplay elements for better phasing.
[*] Some other additional fixes on some visual litches and similar.
[/list]

We once again appreciate everybodies feedback so far and keep them coming so we can improve your experience!

Enjoy, stay safe and keep gaming!

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Countdown to release...1
notes.notes:
Hey hey hey,

We're now less than a day away from the launch and our excitement is over the roof! ːsteamhappyː

Tomorrow, you'll probably be into the game within these hours so we wanted to take a moment and share our tips and tricks regarding on how to play, so let's go :

[olist]
[*] In most beat 'em ups, smashing the attack buttons as hard as you can is the key to success. In Clan N, that tactic might seem to work at first glance but soon you'll realize that your enemies are pretty agile so embrace the roll/dodge and attack blocking mechanics as they'll be your savior in most cases.
[*] You can throw shuriken/knife with tapping onto the relevant button/key but once you hold rather than tap, you'll see that your thrown shuriken/knife has a rope attached to it which you can pull the hit enemy nearby while shouting [b]Get Over Here![/b] ːsteammockingː
[*] Holding down the heavy attack button/key will trigger a charge attack when it's meter is filled (you'll find your character in a hurrican) which will allow you to do auto combo attack to a nearby enemy. Charge attack meter is filled whenever you hit an enemy so it'll be quicker to run a charge attack after you hit a bunch of enemies in advance.
[*] If you hold down left stick/J key while walking, you character will eventually start running and at that state when you attack, you can slash through multiple enemies at once. 
[*] Play the game in [b]hard mode![/b] and start with [b]Short Campaign[/b]. This combination will get you the closes experience to the old school arcade feeling!
[*] Clan N is best played with mulitple players! We already have ingame local/online co-op support and also support Steam's own Remote Play Together feature so you can always find some other people to play together!
[/olist]

Well, that should be all for the tips. Now, do you remember our Mexican Amigos who were having quite a bit of fun while playing Clan N? It seems they continue their video series with the second one and here's that video for your enjoyment :

[previewyoutube=b-H7Xv7bdfY;full][/previewyoutube]

That's all for now again and we hope to see you all with the launch of [b]Clan N[/b] tomorrow!

Regards,

notes.title: Gearing towards the release - Part 3
notes.notes:
Hey There,

We are back once again with some more update and information about our game Clan N.

First, as usual, some update regarding the release. We made a good progress on platform certification, which is needed to be allowed to released on that platform, and already have passed on majority of it, including Steam! There's particularly one platform where there is a specific issue we are trying to solve with the help of the support guys and hope to solve that problem within this week as well! So, it's gettibg very close ːsteamhappyː.

[b]The GamePlay[/b]


By looking into the screenshots and not playing the demo yet ːsteamsadː, you may wonder what makes this game different than the others, apart the very small characters, which is for a reason so let's try to answer this question.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/0d285281f1d18e913b60d82224f831da34eb2e1c.gif[/img]


In our game description we state that Clan N is a mixture of today's modern brawlers with old time arcade beat em ups and this reflects to the core gameplay mechanics. The old beatemups mostly play on 2D horizontal gameplay area, contains a bit of a slow paced movement characteristics and rely on [b]mashing the punch button more leads to win[/b] formula. On the other hand, today's modern brawlers, with the 3D gameplay area prove more freedom on movement, got more tactical with heavy reliance on block and dodge/roll mechanisms as well as speed up in pacing. Also in older games where you could play 2 - 4 players together the modern games mostly turned into one player experiences. With this idea, we constructed [b]Clan N[/b] as ; feeling tight and slick, have the ability to dodge/roll and block from enemy attacks anytime you want and have the ability to play in a 3D area with multiple users. This also reflected the look of the game since with 4 players and enemies along the screen, you need enough play space to use the abilities mentioned above so this made the game items a bit smaller than what people get used to. On the other hand, this also gave a unique character to the game so it's became a win win situation ːsteammockingː.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/6d5c14f038ddabced51e98839e18fd43730af274.gif[/img]


Let's dive a little more into the gameplay aspects. As expected, you have light and heavy attacks bound to different buttons/keys. A combination of light/heavy attack button/key taps allows you to create different combos such as uppercut, air to ground punch, shoulder dash, etc. Combos can only be created while you are hitting an enemy and if you get a hit, it'll get reset. This combo hits does also increase your hit amount which you can see under your character HUD and the more hits you make, the more points you'll add to your score. Not only this, each hit increases your damage you make onto your enemy when you hit so a first hit will be much less effective than the one you make at 15 hits. 

Charge attack is an attack type which is used for automated quick hits to your enemy once activated. It has it's own meter under your character and fills up with every hit you make to enemies. To activate it, you can hold your heavy attack button/key and once you see a tornado character around your character, it's ready so you can just release the button/key to slash the closest enemy you have. 

Another item is the throwable shurikens/knives. Simply tapping the throw button will throw a shuriken/knife into the closest facing enemy and it feels so satisfying to do so! Don't forget that these are limited so use them wisely and collect them through the levels or buy them from the shop. Another neat feature of these shuikens/knives can be attached to ropes, if you hold the throw button rather than tapping, this allows you to pull the hit enemy into nearby to attack him/her further and whenever I do this, I always feel the need to say [b]get over here[/b], I wonder why !?!?! ːsteammockingː

And the last item is a must for every beatem up, your special attack. Each character has it's own unique attack as Akira bening the master of Lightning, Reina beign able to control the Ground to Punch, Daiki being able to create Tornados and Tarou being able to call his Dragons to burst flame into enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/6d57b1d34f59a782ef8372bd62cd64ae39f503fe.gif[/img]


Once again we reached the ending of our another gearing towards the release post series. We hope to see you next time again with hopefully a very happy news! Till than, #StayHome and #KeepGaming...

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Gearing towards the release - Part 2
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Greetings once again and hope that all you are well.

[b]The Release[/b]

First the bad news, we still cannot give you the exact release date yet, apologies for that once again. Apart that, as part of the business, we almost finished all marketing materials as well and you may notice some of them from the updated screenshots which represents the game in final form. Our release trailer is also ready waiting for the release date to be attached before the reveal and than there are some more items which we keep as secret for now!

[b]Who is Clan N[/b]

Clan N is an ancient samurai group in the region of “Far East”, sworn to protect the realm from all who seek its destruction. The four group members consist of the shinobigatana-wielding ninja Akira, the staff-striking Reina, the dual sword-swinging Daiki, and the sickle-slashing monk Tarou.

After years of training and dedication to their respective craft, each character has uncovered their own unique magical abilities. Akira shoots pulse-filled lightning bolts, Reina controls the ground with vicious earthquake shocks, Daiki swirls up brutal tornado waves, and Tarou can call for the help of Dragons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/6e0112ddad037603818c498ff59ab2ffeca5c440.png[/img]

[b]The Story[/b]

Akuji is a former samurai of the Clan N that discovered the balance of the world lies in three areas: Peace, Knowledge, and Time. Akuji found that if you knock the world of one of these, you can harness the powers of “spiritual imbalance” and grow stronger from it. As a result of pursuing spiritual imbalance, he was shunned from the samurai temple and kicked out of Clan N.

What Akuji didn’t know was that attaining spiritual imbalance would not only give you dark powers, it consumed your light and the purity of your life. Following his banishment from the temple and Clan N, Akuji was able to destroy peace by slaughtering villages and retain the power of those he killed, thus absorbing conflict and electric sorcery abilities, becoming the most powerful sorcerer warrior in the Far East. While he continued to grow, Akuji formed Seishin Gun, the spirit group, to join his conquest and remove anyone standing in their path.

Once his actions were discovered by Clan N, they set on a journey to stop the villainous pillaging by Akuji and Seishin Gun.

[b]The Content[/b]

Continuing from our last post, here is further information about the levels in Clan N :

[i]Level 3 - The Unnamed Land[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/6173e1ce0ecd7538faafd3d165a469be4aeb5efe.gif[/img]

Leaving the vermillion caves, emerge into the sunless lands of the unliving. Blooming through the moonlight, the undead thrive & rise again. The unnamed land is just that, an unspoken realm that bewilders the living. Sacred ground or hellbound, no one truly knows.

[i]Level 4 - The Village[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/5daf942e474913a0458ee0ae27e5074fb4f59321.gif[/img]

Surviving through the fuming lands of the undead, you’ve finally reached a prospering land, where dragons and dogwood flourish. Pretty sure nothing could slither its way out of this lovely little village, enjoy the gentle hostilities... hospitality, that is.

Again we reached the ending of another post. See you again in our next gearing towards the release post!

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: Gearing towards the release - Part 1
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

It has been a little while since our last post and we are getting closer to the release. While waiting, we wanted to start a series of postings titled "Gearing towards the release" where we would like to provide you the latest news about the release as well as various information regarding [b]Clan N[/b]'s content and development story/materials. So, let's begin than :

[b]The Release[/b]

It's obvious we are going though one of the toughest times for humanity and this reflects to bussiness as hard as it does in other areas. There's quite a bit of delays on certifications proceedings which affected us quite hard on our timing. Add that our little errors which causes further delays on this process. Still we are doing our best to have this done as soon as possible so we can do a simultaneous release as we always anticipated.

Still, we are eager to show [b]Clan N[/b] to you as soon as possible, so, we'll be updating our demo next week to it's final form to give you a glimpse on the final product ːsteamhappyː.

[b]The Beginnings[/b]

It's quite hard to believe that it has been 6 years when we decided to do a hack'n'slash/brawler/beat'em up game which would feel quite retro as well as modern by combining best of the past and today. It was clear that to achieve this ; a pixel based graphics style with a 3D like playfield and slick/fast paced gameplay.  By this, we also thought we could fullfill the most wanted [b]how you remember your old games played[/b] feeling. After some trial and errors, we came up with this first mockup on how the [b]Clan N[/b] world should look :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/0fd40b951eb802ce73dbdd9e7189a4c1c3dd4844.png[/img]

It was spot on and you might notice how religioulsy we stciked on it. Along the way we made some small size adjustments but apart that, everything stayed as it was imagined from the beginning.

To be honest, not everything was straight forward as it looks and Clan N might have become just another 2D beat'em up game, albeit a classy one, like this :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/f4ee523fd8f48b90ccbd820ddbd93d06ac65df2e.gif[/img]

There were even some lackluster attempts which, god forbid ːsteammockingː , didn't make into the game :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/5a30c1a91d47143fd4e8407face26d18decc9793.png[/img] 

[b]The Content[/b]

In a previous post, we gave you the backstory of the [b]Clan N [/b] universe so now it's time to look into the content inside the game you'll go through on your journey :

Level 1 - The Wilderness

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/2d2649b1323c8a7b61cf96beb8dd1cd480bed1ad.gif[/img]

Travel through the Wilderness is the first part of your journey.

Level 2 - The Cave

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/4f0394ff59bad407f99e9e3eb4bc07b6cef80515.gif[/img]

notes.title: The story so far...
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody,

Today we would like to reveal the story of Clan N and give you more info about the characters and world the game is based on.

[b]About Clan N[/b]

Clan N is an ancient samurai group in the region of “Far East”, sworn to protect the realm from all who seek its destruction. The four group members consist of the shinobigatana-wielding ninja Akira, the staff-striking Reina, the dual sword-swinging Daiki, and the sickle-slashing monk Tarou.

After years of training and dedication to their respective craft, each character has uncovered their own unique magical abilities. Akira shoots pulse-filled lightning bolts, Reina controls the ground with vicious earthquake shocks, Daiki swirls up brutal tornado waves, and Tarou can call for the help of Dragons.

[b]Story[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/f224e9fd4d9bb98e3a7f3cd5bb8c7988112b3626.png[/img]

[b]Akuji[/b] is a former samurai of the Clan N that discovered the balance of the world lies in three areas: Peace, Knowledge, and Time. Akuji found that if you knock the world of one of these, you can harness the powers of “spiritual imbalance” and grow stronger from it. As a result of pursuing spiritual imbalance, he was shunned from the samurai temple and kicked out of Clan N. 

What Akuji didn’t know was that attaining spiritual imbalance would not only give you dark powers, it consumed your light and the purity of your life. Following his banishment from the temple and Clan N, Akuji was able to destroy peace by slaughtering villages and retain the power of those he killed, thus absorbing conflict and electric sorcery abilities, becoming the most powerful sorcerer warrior in the Far East. While he continued to grow, Akuji formed Seishin Gun, the spirit group, to join his conquest and remove anyone standing in their path.

Once his actions were discovered by Clan N, they set on a journey to stop the villainous pillaging by Akuji and Seishin Gun.

[b]About the characters[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34263593/fc4539f93c51746e667d0f072a8163e34d64e20d.png[/img]

[b]Reina [/b] and [b]Daiki[/b] grew as siblings in a southern samurai clan. Reina was not taught the teaching of the clan like her brother Daiki but still observed and learned the ways mastering the staff. She eventually took onto Shamanism as well becoming one of the first shinobi shamans in the land as a young woman. 

[b]Akira [/b] was a childhood friend adopted into the clan as a lost child wandering in the outer lands chased by a pack of wolves, barely making it to the village. Daiki’s father took the child in and raised them, although Akira typically covers himself from head to after severe scarring. 

[b]Tarou [/b] was from the same monastery as Akuji (prior to his joining of Clan N) and learned under the same teachers. Akuji returned to the Monk’s temple many years later and stole an ancient scroll that explained how to destroy the pillars of balance and extract their spiritual imbalance. In pursuit of Akuji, Tarou traced his steps to Clan N. After explaining the situation to the existing three members, they all decided to team up and take down Akuji.

And that's all so far. Hope you liked it and keep providing your feedback to us, either through here or by joining our Discord channel, it means a lot for us. Until next time!

Regards,

Creamative

notes.notes:
Hey Everybody,

Once again after some silence period, we're back with more information and some great news!

First, the bits we are working, which one of them happens to be End Bosses lately. This is one area we are meticulous because it's the pinnacle of each level and we are trying to make them as varying as possible (within our game theme) and also give you some surprises you probably don't expect. As a teaser, take a look at this one small animation :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34263593/d3b7b2b9461dde374c82233adf3906eaedae74fc.gif[/img]

Another area where we are heavily involved on is the intro. A good and compelling introduction to the game is one of our goals and what is better than a saturday morning cartoon feeling animation to do that? 😋 Here's a concept shot from that below as well :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34263593/733823b7678a9a0e4989c3ac1306963b7a0de7a3.png[/img]

Another very important item is the Online Co-op feature. We believe that "Clan N" can be enjoyed the most when played with co-op. Most of the time you'll have your friends sitting on your couch to enjoy it the fullest but in case you don't have that time, finding a game session buddy around the globe would be the second best. This is something we planned to be a must added feature from day one of our development and our recent tests show that it's shaping up to be very well. We even thought of adding a cross platform multiplayer but it seems the bureaucracy and extra work involving on it to bring alive would be too much for us so we had to skip it for now but who knows what future may bring, ha?  😊 Here's also another teaser why coop is quite important in "Clan N" : 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34263593/c73f4c22a31dddec182d616e33dfab8d0cc9fc15.png[/img]

And one last bit of news before we wrap this up ; we know that you are eager to have a taste of our game so we are proud to let you know that this Friday (August 23th) we'll be releasing our public alpha demo through Steam for your enjoyment. It'll contain a good portion of the first level with the ability to play solo or local coop, so mark your calendars and hope to here from you all once it's released! 🤗

Thanks again for all your interest so far and see you again in another update post soon!

Regards,

Creamative

notes.title: "How is everything going?", May/2019 edition #1! 😋
notes.notes:
Hello Everybody,

It has been some time since the last post but no worries, everything is going fine on our side.

Just to give you the state we are at ; the game is almost complete and we are at the stage where we are polishing and fine tuning lots of small items. All the levels are roughly completed with very small missing areas and we are fine tuning all the enemy appearances and balance as well. This tuning also includes the minigames for a tighter integration with the main story.

While speaking with minigames, allow me to give you some more information on what they are and their purpose. Our motto is "games from the past for the future"  where we aim to blend the glory pixelated days with the current refined game mechanics and play and one of today's fact is the overwhelmingly addictive casual games mostly appear on mobile gaming area. We thought that referencing those games with the possibility to integrate into our core game mechanic would be a nice variety for our game. To see what I mean, just check out the "Dodge the Rock" gameplay footage below :

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34263593/0baa19e22568118001e23aa28bf280ebcd34aad8.gif[/img]

Be also aware that you'll be able to play those minigames as standalone sessions as well to have a short fun time alone or with your friends. We'll give you more on the minigames in the following days...

That's all for now and expect much more to hear from us in the following days...

Regards,

Creamative
